problem:
The product of all nine $9$th roots of unity is equal to$\,$
{{field-1}}.

feedback.problem:
The product of all two second roots of unity is equal to$\,$
{{field-1}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that the principal second root of unity is 

$$
z={e}^{2\pi \text{i}/2}={e}^{\pi \text{i}}.
$$

and that any second root of unity is of the form ${z}^{k}$ for $k=0,1.$ 
Therefore, the product of all two roots is

$$
\begin{aligned}{z}^{0}\cdot {z}^{1} & ={z}^{0\,+\,1} \\  & ={z}^{1} \\  & =z \\  & ={e}^{\pi \text{i}} \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$
